# Rank Me Higher

> Rank Me Higher is the AI-autonomous growth platform for local businesses. The AI researches your market, plans your website, builds it in minutes with real photos and natural AI imagery, texts you progress, and puts it live. You edit anything by chatting with it. One portal, one subscription. Built in Chicago.

## The Offer

Get a FREE website that dominates Google — built by AI in minutes. The free build is real: the AI researches your market, builds the complete site, and texts you a live preview link. No card required. Going live on your own domain is a subscription starting at $99/mo.

## How It Works (Live Today)

1. Take the free website quiz at https://rankmehigher.com/#free-website
2. The AI researches your business, your area, and what customers search for
3. It plans and builds a complete local-SEO-correct website in minutes — real business photos plus natural AI imagery
4. You get progress updates by SMS and email, ending with a live preview link
5. Go live on your custom domain (hosting, SSL handled) with a subscription
6. Edit anything by chatting with the AI — every change is versioned and revertable
7. Every lead your site captures is delivered instantly by SMS, email, and webhooks, and logged in your portal

## Pricing

- **$99/mo** — website live on your domain, hosting, SSL, chat edits, lead capture with instant delivery, client portal
- **$149/mo** — everything in $99, plus automatic Google Business Profile optimization
- **$199/mo** — everything in $149, plus review generator with a dedicated business phone number and branded email

## Platform Direction (Coming, Not Live Yet)

- Google rankings tracked inside your portal
- Request tasks that the AI just does
- Automatic Google Business Profile optimization
- Automated review generation

## What "Local-SEO-Correct" Means

Every website the AI builds ships with: consistent NAP (name, address, phone) on every page, JSON-LD structured data, honest business hours, dedicated city and service pages, and fast mobile-compact pages.

## Businesses On The Platform

Published examples are Truck Clinic in Romeoville and QTA Tax in Oak Brook.

## FAQs

**Is the free website really free?**
Yes. The AI builds the complete site and texts you a live preview link, no card required. You pay only when you put it live on your own domain, from $99/mo.

**How fast is the build?**
Minutes. Research, plan, build — then the preview link is texted to you.

**How do I edit my website?**
Chat with the AI. Click anything, say the change. Every edit is versioned and revertable.

**Do you handle hosting and domains?**
Yes. Hosting, SSL, and your custom domain are included in every plan.

**What happens to leads?**
They're delivered instantly by SMS and email (webhooks available) and logged in your portal. The $199/mo plan adds a dedicated business phone number.

**Do you work outside Chicago?**
Yes — the platform serves local businesses across the United States.
